For purposes of these Terms, each Dropbox Team or non-Dropbox Team workspace you join will be considered its own account. Your use of each account will be governed by the respective legal agreement applicable to that account type as set forth above.  

Actions taken on one account, including suspension, deletion, termination, or removal from a Dropbox Team, may impact your access to or use of the Services. For example, if your Admin removes you from their team and deletes your account on that team, you may be unable to access your other accounts until you change the email address for those accounts.
